question: The ‘Family Doctor’ programme launched on a pilot basis in the first week of September 2022. This programme was launched by which state government?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Andhra Pradesh**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The State Government of** Andhra Pradesh** has decided to implement the “Family Doctor Project” on a pilot basis in **Padmanabham Mandal of Visakhapatnam district**.
 
• Family Doctor Program is mainly introduced to establish village health clinics in every village.
 
• Every village health clinic is connected with the Grama Sachivalyams.
 
• As a part of this telemedicine is also provided to patients.
 
• Nurses and ASHA workers are present in these clinics.
 
• Under this scheme, two PHCs are present in each Mandal.
 
• The medical officers are known for being present at these PHCs 24x7.
